label: Backpack
intent: The pack is zipped shut, ready to go. Light: the zip across the flap runs open to the left, then closes back across to the right with a hit, and the pull tugs the pack after it, leaning left then right; the zipped pack hops once and lands with a small bounce. Strong: the zip opens, pauses, and snaps shut harder; the pack hops higher and lands with two decaying bounces while the fabric grab loop lags: it stretches at the top of the hop, squashes on landing and springs back. The pack stays one rigid piece.

slot.//: v1's Solid flap slot: drawn in no outline style, only cut from the body in Solid (a trimmed slot made slivers)

flap.//: the zip: it draws back to the left and closes again; in Solid the static slot stands for it

loop.//: the fabric grab loop flexes from where it is sewn on

pack.rotate.//: the zip pull tugs the pack: it leans after the pull as the zip runs open, then the other way as it closes
